brad-sherman.text: Cosponsored the Green New Deal when introduced in 2019 and has helped reintroduce it each time; supports declaring a national climate emergency and the Energy Innovation and Carbon Dividend Act (a fee on the carbon content of fossil fuels).

source.title: Brad Sherman for Congress - Issues

brad-sherman.text: Helped introduce the West Coast Protection Act, which would ban new federal oil and gas leases off California, Oregon and Washington; also supports the Break Free from Plastic Pollution Act.

larry-thompson.text: On abortion: "As a Christian, I am personally against it. As your Congressman, I believe the law is clear. It's not an issue for the national government anymore." Says states will set policy and he does not believe in a federal law banning a woman's right to choose.

source.title: Larry Thompson for U.S. Congress - On the Issues

larry-thompson.text: On guns: "I will not disarm law-abiding citizens who have every right and increasing need to defend themselves." To curb gun violence, prosecute criminals who use guns: "Use a Gun, Go to Prison."

source.title: Larry Thompson for U.S. Congress - On the Issues

larry-thompson.text: On the border: "Keep the damn thing closed. Deport those who are here illegally, and govern by the existing, long-standing immigration laws of our land." Also lists comprehensive immigration reform among his goals.

source.title: Larry Thompson for U.S. Congress - On the Issues

larry-thompson.text: On crime: "I am very tough on crime. We need to support our men and women in blue and prosecute criminals according to the letter and spirit of the law."

source.title: Larry Thompson for U.S. Congress - On the Issues

larry-thompson.text: On taxes: "Lower them all, and eliminate some. No taxes on Social Security and no taxes on tips and overtime." Also supports the argument that Measure ULA (the "Mansion Tax") is invalid and unconstitutional.

source.title: Larry Thompson for U.S. Congress - On the Issues

larry-thompson.text: Proposes the American Work Freedom Act of 2027: complete phase-out of federal income taxes over four years while protecting Social Security, Medicare, national defense, veterans benefits and federal law enforcement.

larry-thompson.text: On homelessness: house and treat people in existing closed mental institutions, drug addiction facilities and veteran homes, and encourage religious organizations to co-sponsor Good Samaritan efforts.

source.title: Larry Thompson for U.S. Congress - On the Issues

larry-thompson.text: On climate: "I am for allowing all alternate forms of energy and American oil to compete in a free market."

source.title: Larry Thompson for U.S. Congress - On the Issues

larry-thompson.text: On education: schools must be "assertively transparent" with parents about what is taught in classrooms and which ideologies are government-funded.

source.title: Larry Thompson for U.S. Congress - On the Issues

larry-thompson.text: On the economy: stop printing money and lower the national debt by a minimum of 10% each year until paid off.

larry-thompson.text: Lists among his goals to "improve wages, health care, schools, and public transportation" and to represent every person "of every race, creed, color, and sexual preference." No specific policy mechanisms given.
